modules.title: It's good to join clubs
sentences: Shenshen, it's your photo.
So sweet.
I love it!
Thank you, Xiaojiang.
I'm glad you like it.
Taking photos helps me keep the sweet moments in life.
I'm going to join the Photography Club this term.
Good idea.
You can meet new friends and have fun at the same time!
Look, this is Xiaopu's painting.
Wow, the night view of the Huangpu River.
It's beautiful!
I love this painting too.
The colours are just amazing.
Xiaopu learns how to use colours well in the Art Club.
It's fun to play with colours.
That's nice.
I am going to join the Art Club.
I'd like to give it a try.
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [18]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: At the Pottery Club
sentences: At the Pottery Club, Miss Li says, All the brush pots are dry now.
Today, you need to paint them.
James gets his brush pot.
It doesn't look very nice!
Don't worry, Miss Li says.
It's about to change.
What do you think I should paint?
James asks Xiaopu.
How about bamboo?
Bamboo is one of the four noble plants in Chinese culture.
Good idea!
James begins to paint.
Oh, it's hard to draw the leaves!
James says.
Don't give up.
Draw like this!
Xiaopu shows James.
At last, James makes a nice bamboo brush pot.
With your help, it becomes easier!
James says.
notes: 句子 0 疑似引语边界拼接，请人工核对：At the Pottery Club, Miss Li says, All the brush pots are dry now.

modules.title: As fast as the wind
sentences: Mr Zhong, is this Shaolin kung fu?
This is changquan — Long Fist.
It's the mother of many kung fu styles.
Oh, I see.
Many kung fu styles come from Long Fist?
That's right!
It's amazing!
There are twelve kinds of actions.
Look, what does this look like?
A tree?
Correct.
Stand like a pine tree.
Very strong and proud.
Look at us.
Three straight trees!
Excellent!
Let me show you another one.
What does this look like?
I know!
Sit like a bell.
Clever girl!
How about this?
Wow, you move so fast!
As fast as the wind.
I use all my strength for every action.
That's why it's so fast!
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [26]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: The dragon dance
sentences: The students in the dragon dance team are training hard for the coming garden party.
As the head of the dragon, Minmin runs very fast.
Head of the dragon, slow down!
We can't keep up with you!
Xiaopu calls out at the tail of the dragon.
The background music is loud.
Minmin can't hear Xiaopu.
He runs even faster.
The players at the tail of the dragon lose control of the sticks.
Stop!
Mr Zhong calls out.
To play well, all the students at the dragon's head, body and tail need to be in step.
Minmin, listen to the music and follow it.
Everyone, follow Minmin.
Let's try again.
Mr Zhong says.
This time, all the players keep the same pace and the long dragon comes to life.

modules.title: Parts of plants
sentences: The roots hold the plant in place, and take in food and water.
The stem moves water up the plant, and brings water to the leaves.
The leaves take in the sunlight, and grow bigger and bigger.
The flowers soon come out, and grow into a fruit holding seeds.
The seeds fall into the soil, and a new plant grows.

modules.title: A visit to the botanical gardens
sentences: Xiaopu, Xiaotian and Xiaojiang are visiting the botanical gardens.
Wow, the tulips are so beautiful!
This one looks like an ice cream cone.
It has a long stem and big leaves.
Look at the name tag.
It's called an ice cream tulip.
How lovely!
The wall is covered with plants.
They're creepers.
They have short, thick stems.
They can grow all over a wall in a very short time.
Look!
That plant has special leaves, like a mouth with many teeth!
It's a meat-eating plant.
It eats small insects.
That's my favourite flower.
Ah, water lilies.
These broad leaves look like lovely green umbrellas.
Look, the pink flowers are so beautiful!
The flowers grow from the mud under the water.
But they are still clean and beautiful.
Isn't it amazing?
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [34]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: Plants and the weather
sentences: Can plants tell us about the weather?
The marvel of Peru or the four-o'clock flower can tell you about the day's weather.
If the flowers close up or fade early in the morning, it is going to be a sunny day.
If the flowers are still open after 6 a.m., it is going to be cloudy or rainy.
Some plants react to weather changes.
For example, on sunny days, pine cones' scales are open.
On rainy days, they fold their scales to protect their seeds.
Morning glory petals open during nice days, but close tightly when rain is coming.
Many other plants are wonderful weather reporters too.
Can you find out some of them?

modules.title: In a safari park
sentences: I love this safari truck tour.
I feel so close to all the animals.
I do too.
Look at the beautiful flamingos there.
Not all of them are pink.
Now I know pandas eat more than bamboos.
Look!
Mommy giraffes are taking care of their babies.
How sweet!
Is that animal keeper trying to feed the giraffes?
Well, he's going to give the baby giraffes injections to keep them healthy.
He tries to get closer to them with their favourite food.
See?
They are good friends.
Yes.
We're all friends to animals.
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [42]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: The animal observation diary
sentences: Sangsang is a panda cub.
I saw her birth last week.
She looks different from her mother.
She isn't black and white, but pink with a little bit of white hair.
She can't open her eyes, but she can crawl.
She is so lovely!
Momo, the hippo is one month old.
He spends the day resting in water.
He can walk in the water.
At night, he goes with his mother to sleep on land.
Momo is learning how to dive.
Today, I saw Momo keeping his head under water for 5 minutes.
Kangkang is a nineteen-year-old Asian elephant.
In eight months, she will give birth to a little baby.
At noon, I saw her standing under the tree and sleeping.
In the afternoon, I fed her grass and leaves.
She ate a lot!

modules.title: Nice doctors
sentences: My arm hurts badly, so I come to see Dr Cai.
He is very nice and says kindly, I know it hurts.
It's OK to cry.
He treats the wound carefully.
Try not to touch it.
And keep it dry.
Let it heal up nicely.
My nose is runny and I cough badly, so I come to see Dr Li.
A nurse takes my temperature, and Dr Li is very nice and says gently, You have a fever.
And it's the flu.
Take some medicine and have a good rest.
Drink lots of water.
And take it easy.
notes: 句子 1 疑似引语边界拼接，请人工核对：He is very nice and says kindly, I know it hurts.
句子 8 疑似引语边界拼接，请人工核对：A nurse takes my temperature, and Dr Li is very nice and says gently, You have a fever.

modules.title: At the eye clinic
sentences: How can I help you?
Doctor, I can't see clearly these days.
Let me check your eyes. ...
Do you watch TV or play computer games a lot?
Yes, I do.
Well, I'm afraid you use your eyes too much.
What should I do then?
Can you give me some medicine for my eyes, please?
There is no need for medicine, young man.
You need to watch less TV and play fewer computer games.
Go out and do your favourite outdoor activities more.
For example, you can go cycling or play football more.
They are good for your eyes.
And don't forget to do eye exercises twice a day.
Thank you, doctor.
I will take good care of my eyes.
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [50]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: The story of Hua Tuo
sentences: Ouch!
Ouch!
The patient cried.
How can I reduce his pain during the treatment?
Hua Tuo thought.
One day, Hua Tuo had a patient with a broken leg.
The man broke his leg after drinking.
During the whole treatment, the man stayed asleep.
Hua Tuo was surprised.
He had an idea: I need some medicine to keep my patients asleep during the treatment.
A few days later, a mother came in with a child in her arms.
The child ate some white flowers by mistake and his mother couldn't wake him up.
But an hour later, the boy woke up by himself and everything was OK with him.
The white flower was choumazi.
With this plant, Hua Tuo created a medicine called mafeisan.
It helped many patients in need of operation.

modules.title: Be better
sentences: Shenshen won a prize in a storytelling contest.
Well done, Shenshen!
Thank you, Minmin.
Shenshen, I still remember the first time I met you.
You were shy and quiet.
But you are so confident today.
Yeah, I used to be very nervous to speak in front of my schoolmates.
You are now a good storyteller.
How did you make it?
To me, telling stories to lots of people is really cool.
I learned from videos and did a lot of practice.
What else?
I told stories to my family.
They made videos for me and gave me advice.
I see.
Love and practice make a better you.
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [58]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: My left foot
sentences: When I was four months old, I was sick.
The only body part I could control was my left foot.
My mum didn't give up.
She taught me how to read and write.
Do you like this story? she asked, Nod your head for yes.
I couldn't make any signs, but Mum told me more stories.
When I was five, I was still unable to speak.
One day, I was watching my sister using a piece of yellow chalk to write.
Then I took the chalk from my sister with my left foot.
Very slowly, I held the chalk tightly between my toes and wrote the letter A!
I couldn't speak, but that one letter was my road to a new world.
notes: 句子 4 疑似引语边界拼接，请人工核对：Do you like this story? she asked, Nod your head for yes.

modules.title: Science
sentences: Science opens a window for humans.
With science, we can go farther.
With science, we can fly higher.
With science, we find out why apples fall to the ground.
With science, we now know why the earth goes around the sun.
Science helps us understand the world around us.
Science helps us explore outer space.
Science is cool.
It's really cool to be a scientist!

modules.title: Do you know them?
sentences: Look at these photos of famous scientists.
Oh, this is Tu Youyou, a Nobel Prize winner.
Yes.
What do you know about her?
She discovered qinghaosu and has saved many lives.
Wow.
She is great!
Look here!
It's Newton.
Do you know the story of Newton's apple?
Yes, I do.
The story is like this.
Young Newton was thinking about the universe under an apple tree.
Suddenly an apple fell on his head.
He thought hard about the reasons for the fall of apples.
And later he discovered the Law of Gravity.
Look, Qian Xuesen, a rocket scientist.
I'm a big fan of him.
I'm also interested in outer space.
I want to be a scientist like him in the future.
Your dream will come true.
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [66]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: Great scientists
sentences: Yuan Longping was born in Beijing in 1930.
In the 1960s, as the nation was short of food, Mr Yuan began to do research on hybrid rice.
He was creative and hard-working.
His hybrid rice has fed many people.
Mr Yuan is known as the Father of Hybrid Rice.
Alexander Graham Bell was born in Scotland in 1847.
He was always curious about new things.
He and his assistant Thomas Watson invented the world's first practical telephone.
Bell was interested in many research areas.
He invented a lot of techniques to help the deaf.

modules.title: New inventions
sentences: Welcome, boys and girls!
It's our Science Day.
We have Mr Qian with us to talk about some new inventions.
Hi, I've got some interesting things to tell you today.
Look, this invention is very useful.
You pour in sea water and let the sun do the work for a few hours.
Then you have clean fresh water!
How nice!
Look, these are also great inventions from Chinese scientists.
In 2019, they explored the dark side of the moon.
Oh, Chang'e-4 and Yutu-2.
They took amazing photos and sent them back.
Yes.
We know so little about that part of the moon and it's important to find out more.
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [74]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: The wheel moves on
sentences: The wheel is an old invention.
It dates back to over 5,000 years ago.
Now we can find wheels almost everywhere around us.
For example, there are wheels at home, in the street and in the classroom.
We can find wheels in a clock, an electric fan, a juicer and a washing machine.
We can find wheels on a bus, a bike, a train and an airplane.
Sometimes we can also find wheels on chairs or desks.
The wheel is one of the most important inventions.
Wheels make housework much easier.
Wheels help people travel around easily and comfortably.
And wheels help people carry heavy things.
Thanks to the wheel, we are able to save time and work to make more inventions.

modules.title: Interesting facts about computers
sentences: Xiaopu and his father are reading a book about computers.
Dad, what is it?
It is ENIAC, the best-known early computer.
A computer?!
But it has no mouse or keyboard?
The first computer did not have a mouse or keyboard.
It was as big as a room.
Besides, it was 30 tons.
It was as heavy as four elephants.
People used it to do difficult maths tasks.
Cool!
But today computers are much smaller.
What makes this happen?
The microchip.
Microchips are very important to computers.
With microchips, scientists can make very small computers.
How small can a computer be now?
In 2018, scientists made super small computers.
They were as small as a grain of salt.
How amazing!
I love computers.
We can do a lot of things with a computer now.
My classmates and I can send emails, search for information and do our homework better.
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [82]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: Got a problem? Ask Simon!
sentences: I've got a new computer as a gift from my grandpa.
My little brother often turns on my computer and messes up my files.
It's really bad.
What should I do?
You need to set a power-on password.
You can set a password by using eight different letters, numbers and symbols.
Keep it to yourself and don't tell others.
Good luck.
I carelessly dropped some milk on the desktop keyboard.
Now my keyboard does not work.
I am worried.
Is my computer broken?
I don't know what to do.
Please help me!
A little milk on the keyboard does not matter too much.
Clean the keyboard first.
And leave it to dry.
If you are worried, you can ask parents to help you check the computer.
Remember, do not drink milk or other drinks while using the computer in the future.

modules.title: Reduce, reuse, recycle
sentences: Do not go to school by car every day.
Take a bus, take the subway, or walk if you may.
It's a great way to reduce.
Do not throw the old toys away.
Give them to little kids to play with.
It's a great way to reuse.
Do not use a plastic bag day after day.
A cloth bag or a paper one is also okay.
It's a great way to recycle.
Reduce, reuse and recycle to make our life greener every day.

modules.title: Habits for a greener life
sentences: Boys and girls, what can we do to live a greener life?
I turn off the tap when I brush my teeth.
Good boy!
Every time we do this, we save water.
I use both sides of the paper.
Good.
You see, paper is made from wood.
Use less paper and we can save a lot of trees.
I remind my mum to unplug the TV from the wall.
Right.
Always unplug your TV after watching.
It is a good way to save energy.
I like walking to school every day.
It is a good way to reduce air pollution.
Yes, and it's a healthy habit too.
I plant seeds and watch them grow.
Good idea.
Plants help keep the air clean and fresh.
notes: 对话后续页（PDF [90]）没有 14pt Regular 正文，确认无遗漏。

modules.title: Baggie's new life
sentences: Baggie is a plastic bag.
Someone drops it into the sea.
Baggie is very sad.
Suddenly, a big whale swims by and eats it up.
Oh, no, it's not a jellyfish and it can make me ill.
The whale sneezes and opens his mouth wide.
Baggie comes out quickly.
A moment later, a sea turtle spots Baggie and swallows it.
Oh, no, it's not a jellyfish and it can make me very ill.
The turtle coughs hard and Baggie comes out all at once.
A big wave carries Baggie to the beach.
Before long, a boy comes by.
Plastic bags should not lie around, the boy says.
He picks Baggie up and makes it into a kite.
Now Baggie is happy, Wow, I'm flying and I'm useful again!
notes: 句子 14 疑似引语边界拼接，请人工核对：Now Baggie is happy, Wow, I'm flying and I'm useful again!
